title: Change is Coming to xAI After Musk Merges it with SpaceX
content:
# 在马斯克将 xAI 与 SpaceX 合并后，xAI 即将迎来变革
此举可能是马斯克为了提升 xAI 在竞争对手中的地位，或是为了调整这家人工智能公司的发展方向。
[Esther Shittu](https://aibusiness.com/author/esther-shittu)，AI Business 新闻撰稿人
2026 年 2 月 3 日
![SpaceX 标志和 xAI 在手机上的图片](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/blt494508282098f6bc/69824eccb589207f8d6f7d38/SpaceX.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)
埃隆·马斯克将其火箭公司 SpaceX 与其人工智能初创公司 xAI 以 1.25 万亿美元的价格合并，这可能会为这家人工智能初创公司提供必要的现金和支持，使其在人工智能市场上保持竞争力并具有相关性，因为它正准备与竞争对手 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 一起上市。
相关报道：[Snowflake 交易是 OpenAI 进入企业市场的最新举措](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/snowflake-deal-latest-move-by-openai)
马斯克于 2023 年创立了这家人工智能初创公司，此前他正式辞去了 OpenAI 董事会创始成员的职务五年。马斯克还起诉 OpenAI，指控其放弃了最初的非营利性社会使命等等。此后，xAI 发布了多个大型语言模型和其他模型，包括 Grok 系列通用模型和 Aurora，一种文本到图像模型。
### 一位财务支持者
因此，Futurum 的分析师 Nick Patience 表示，这次合并的一个动机纯粹是财务方面的。由于 xAI 每月消耗 10 亿美元的现金，因此它需要更多的财务支持才能留在人工智能竞赛中。
“XAI 需要 SpaceX 的现金产生能力，因为 SpaceX 是盈利的，”Patience 说。“这是一个现金流的故事，因为它……维持了 xAI 的生命。”
他补充说，马斯克建造[轨道数据中心](https://aibusiness.com/verticals/us-space-force-tackles-edge-computing-in-space)以帮助为人工智能技术提供动力的目标是一个宏伟但投机的尝试。
“如果能够做到，那是有道理的，因为它能够解决我们在冷却和土地使用方面的地面限制，”Patience 说。“但存在重大未知数。”他补充说，挑战包括轨道碎片、硬件维护和监管考虑。
相关报道：[谷歌在美国推出低成本 AI Plus 订阅服务](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/google-launches-ai-plus-subscription-us)
这些考虑因素使轨道数据中心成为一项长期押注，而不是短期期望。
“它呈现了一个不同的故事，一个世界上没有其他公司拥有的垂直整合故事，”Patience 说。
随着马斯克准备今年夏天将该公司上市，目标估值为 1.5 万亿美元，这种“垂直整合”战略可能会有所帮助，因为估计的估值超过 1 万亿美元，使其成为世界上最有价值的私营公司。
### 不同的动机
然而，分析公司 Nemertes 的首席执行官 Johna Till Johnson 表示，估计的估值可能存在缺陷。
“一家私营公司的价值……就是投资它的人所说的价值，”她说，并补充说，当公司上市时，它往往未能达到预期。
此外，Johnson 说，尽管人工智能技术将来可能对太空有所帮助，但马斯克的动机可能是为了避免批评他管理着太多的公司，因为他正准备进行首次公开募股。
相关报道：[微软旨在通过 Maia 200 提高推理效率](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/microsoft-aims-for-better-inference-efficiency)
此外，合并可能意味着 xAI 可能是马斯克用来保持 SpaceX 卫星网络运行的通用人工智能实验室，也可能是一家完全专注于太空的人工智能公司，这将与其目前的角色有所转变，她补充说。
“除非他……计划将这件事从它目前正在做的事情完全重新定位到其他事情……坦率地说，他将保持它的通用性，因此唯一真正的价值在于它是他担任老板的一家公司，”她说。
## 关于作者
AI Business 新闻撰稿人
Esther Shittu 拥有四年的人工智能技术和行业趋势报道经验。作为“Targeting AI”播客的联合主持人，她与思想领袖和从业者探讨关键的人工智能发展。在加入 AI Business 之前，她曾为多家出版物撰稿，包括《纽约每日新闻》、《布克林人》和《布鲁克林每日鹰报》。当她不深入研究人工智能世界时，她会将时间花在热情项目和抚养她的三个女儿上。

# Change is Coming to xAI After Musk Merges it with SpaceX
The move could be an attempt by Musk to prop up xAI's standing with competitors, or a redirection for the AI firm.
[Esther Shittu](https://aibusiness.com/author/esther-shittu), News Writer, AI Business
February 3, 2026
![Pic of SpaceX logo and xAI on mobile](https://eu-images.contentstack.com/v3/assets/blt6b0f74e5591baa03/blt494508282098f6bc/69824eccb589207f8d6f7d38/SpaceX.jpg?width=1280&auto=webp&quality=80&format=jpg&disable=upscale)
Elon Musk’s combination of his rocket company SpaceX with his AI startup xAI for $1.25 trillion could provide the AI startup the necessary cash and backing it needs to stay competitive and relevant in the AI market, as it prepares to go public alongside competitors OpenAI and Anthropic.
Related: [Snowflake Deal Latest Move into Enterprise Market by OpenAI](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/snowflake-deal-latest-move-by-openai)
Musk founded the AI startup in 2023, five years after officially resigning from the OpenAI board as a founding member. Musk has also sued OpenAI for allegedly abandoning its original nonprofit social mission, among other things. Since then, xAI has released multiple large language and other models, including the Grok series of general-purpose models and Aurora, a text-to-image model.
### A Financial Backer
Therefore, one motivation for this merger is purely financial, said Nick Patience, an analyst at Futurum. With xAI burning through a billion dollars in cash a month, it needs more financial backing to stay in the AI race.
“XAI needs this SpaceX cash generation ability because SpaceX is profitable,” Patience said. “This is a cash flow story in that …. it sustains the life of xAI.”
He added that Musk’s goal of building [orbital data centers](https://aibusiness.com/verticals/us-space-force-tackles-edge-computing-in-space) to help power AI technology is a grand but speculative endeavor.
“There is a rationale if it could be done because it could solve the terrestrial constraints we have around cooling and land use,” Patience said. “But there are significant unknowns.” He added that the challenges include orbital debris, hardware maintenance, and regulatory considerations.
Related: [Google Launches Low-Cost AI Plus Subscription in the U.S.](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/google-launches-ai-plus-subscription-us)
Those considerations make orbital data centers a long-term bet and not a short-term expectation.
“It presents a different story, a vertical integration story that no other company in the world has,” Patience said.
This “vertical integration” strategy could be helpful as Musk prepares to take the company public this summer, with a target valuation of $1.5 trillion, as the estimated valuation surpasses $1 trillion, making it the world's most valuable private company.
### Different Motivations
However, estimated valuations can be faulty, said Johna Till Johnson, CEO of analyst firm Nemertes.
“The value of a private company is … whatever the people investing in it say it is,” she said, adding that it can often fail to meet expectations when the company goes public.
Moreover, although AI technology could be helpful in space in the future, Musk’s motivation could be a way to avoid criticism that he is managing too many companies as he prepares for an IPO, Johnson said.
Related: [Microsoft Aims for Better Inference Efficiency With Maia 200](https://aibusiness.com/generative-ai/microsoft-aims-for-better-inference-efficiency)
Furthermore, the merger could mean that xAI could either be a general-purpose AI lab that Musk uses to keep SpaceX’s satellite networks running or an AI company focused solely on space, which would be a pivot from its current role, she added.
“Unless he ... is planning to take this thing and refocus it entirely from what it's currently doing to something else … quite frankly, he's going to maintain it as its general purpose, and therefore the only real value is that it's one company that he's boss of,” she said.
## About the Author
News Writer, AI Business
Esther Shittu brings four years of expertise covering artificial intelligence technologies and industry trends. As co-host of the "Targeting AI" podcast, she talks to thought leaders and practitioners exploring critical AI developments. Previous to AI Business, she wrote for several publications including the New York Daily News, Bklyner and the Brooklyn Daily Eagle. When she's not diving deep into the world of AI, she spends her time on passion projects and raising her three daughters.
